astringency_polyphenol_ceiling.name: Astringency / Polyphenol Ceiling
astringency_polyphenol_ceiling.description: Upper limit to avoid hop bite and tannin extraction.

flameout_stand.name: Flameout Stand
flameout_stand.description: Maximum bittering. Tannin and astringency risk. High volatile oils (e.g. myrcene) evaporative decay.

isomerization_floor.name: Isomerization Floor
isomerization_floor.description: Below this range, alpha-acid isomerization effectively nears zero. Classic "cool whirlpool" or "hop stand" temperature. Massive flavor and aroma extraction
